table.retrieve:
SELECT
	VisitCode,
	Date,
	AppointmentCode,
	Token=0,
	DoctCode,
	VisitTypeCode,
	VisitStatusCode,
	Regno = (SELECT Patient.RegNo FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = Visit.PatientCode),
	PatientCode,
	PatientDetails,
	ReferredBy,
	PreviousDiagnosis,
	Diagnosis,
	Recommendations,
	Remarks,
	Precautions,
	VisitFee,
	FollowUpDays,
	FollowUpDate,
	EstimatedPatientCount=ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(V.VisitCode) FROM Visit V WHERE CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), DateAdd(dd, V.FollowUpDAys, V.Date), 101) AS DATETIME) = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), DateAdd(dd, Visit.FollowUpDAys, Visit.Date), 101) AS DATETIME)), 0),
	Usercode,
	Posted,
	MaxEstPatientCount=ISNULL((SELECT D.EstPatientCountPerDay FROM Doctors D WHERE D.DoctCode = Visit.DoctCode),0)
FROM
	Visit
WHERE
	VisitCode = :ai_code
